meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 给网页、终端界面和分页文档做视觉质检：截取证据图，运行脚本对比或检查，再派两个只读审查员各自审核源码与截图，最终给出“通过/不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或改动页面、组件或终端界面后，或询问它们看起来是否正确时触发。

say.text: 我刚改完页面，帮我检查一下视觉问题。
say.note: 自动截图并运行检查，反馈过/不过。

say.text: 拿这张设计稿和我现在的页面比一比。
say.note: 会按相同视口截图做像素比对。

say.text: 终端里这个界面显示有没有问题？
say.note: 抓取终端画面检查宽度和边框。

howto.what_en: Runs visual QA on rendered surfaces (web, terminal, paginated docs): captures evidence, runs script checks or diffs, dispatches two read-only reviewers to inspect source and screenshots, then returns a single pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after you build or change any page, component, or terminal UI, or when you ask whether one looks right.

say_en.text: I just changed the page; run a visual check.
Compare this design mock with my current page.
say_en.note: Shoots both at same viewport and pixel-diffs them.

say_en.text: Does this terminal UI display correctly?
say_en.note: Captures the terminal and checks width and borders.
